title: Add the merge_ready helper and set/clear it from the cap and reopen paths
action: Create verbs/workflow_store/merge_ready.rs (register in workflow_store/mod.rs, pub(crate)) with four fail-open functions that never change a verb's own result: `set_after_cap(root, feature, now_iso) -> Option<Value>`, `clear(root, feature) -> bool`, `set_uat(root, feature, approved: bool) -> bool`, `set_blocked_by(root, feature, doors: &[&str]) -> bool`. All four resolve the feature's record through state_group/ledger.rs `resolve_mutation_lock_scope` + `acquire_mutation_locks` + `resolve_mutation_target(root, Some(feature), "merge_ready", false)` (lane when .bee/lanes/<feature>.json exists, else the default record when its feature equals <feature>; otherwise no-op) and write with `write_through_projection` so projections rebuild (per D1/D3). `set_after_cap` per D1: compute with `verbs/cells/read.rs list_cells(root, Some(feature), Some(status))` — set only when open==0 and claimed==0 and blocked==0 and capped>=1, AND `status_full/topology.rs find_granted_worktree_for_feature(root, feature)` returns Some((worktree_id, worktree_root)); branch = `wt/<feature>` unless the worktree's current branch (merge.rs current_branch(worktree_root)) reads otherwise; value = {since: now_iso, branch, worktree_id, uat: "approved" if approved_gates.uat is true else "pending", blocked_by: []}; when merge_ready already exists keep its since, blocked_by and uat and only refresh branch/worktree_id. `clear` removes the key (per D2). Wire: in handlers_close.rs `cap_cell_from_flags` after the claim release (the slot between release_claim_file_best_effort and Ok(saved), around :561) call set_after_cap with the cell's feature and record the returned value under the cap result as `merge_ready` (null when not set) — note cells finish runs at MAIN's store root, so root is the control root; in `run_reopen` (:956 -> :994), `unclaim_cell` (:917 -> :948) and handlers_meta.rs judge-record NEEDS_REVISION reopen (:261-283) call `clear` with the cell's feature after the status flips to open. Tests in verbs/cells/tests.rs (tempdir + write_cell_fixture + a fake grant: write .bee/runtime/worktree-grants.json {"<repo>--wt--<f>": true} plus .bee/runtime/workspaces/<id>.json and a .bee/runtime/worktree-identity.json-bearing worktree dir the way topology tests do, or stub via the existing helper if one exists): last cap with grant sets merge_ready with uat pending; cap with an open sibling does not; cap with no grant does not; reopen clears; second last-cap after reopen gets a fresh since; corrupt lane file leaves the cap result intact with merge_ready null. Commit trailer `cell: mrf-1`.

truths: the cap that leaves zero open/claimed/blocked cells for a feature with a worktree grant writes merge_ready onto the feature's record
a cap with an open sibling, with no grant, or for a zero-cell feature writes nothing
cells reopen, cells unclaim and a NEEDS_REVISION judge-record remove merge_ready
a corrupt record never changes the cap's own outcome
